title: anthephora elegans
intro: Anthephora elegans, commonly known as Black Needle Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, due to its reported health benefits. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Anthephora elegans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
